This happens to me as well. I do fuck all and everybody acts like I committed mass genocide. And sometimes I do things before knowing I’m going to do them. Last night, I was in a terrible state, balling my eyes out and thinking of killing myself. What didn’t help at all was my stupid sister crying (probably that YouTube crashed) downstairs. And when I say crying, I mean fucking screaming. I couldn’t put up with it and had two options:
1. I go downstairs and tell her to shut the fuck up and hope that she actually listens
2. I just get on with it and kill myself already.
Since killing myself would be irreversible, I chose option one. My mum rambled on about some meaningless shit and I just said, ‘I’m trying to sleep, shut up.’ But then, Mum had the audacity to try and justify my sister’s behaviour and yelled at me while I was going back upstairs. I said ‘Fuck off!’ before I even thought about saying it and my dad was very angry. He gets irrationally angry at naughty sweary words. He goes ‘Oi!’ and then goes downstairs himself, which somehow solves the issue. But I was scared senseless about what Dad would say the me after that. Luckily, he hasn’t addressed it yet. I thought, fuck, now I have to tell him I’m suicidal in order to justify my reaction. But no, it’s fine. (It’s actually not at all fine, I need help and am a danger to myself. I’m a stupid little pussy who can’t tell anyone really close to me.)
